details.summary: What the search changes — and what it protects
details.p: It varies three things: how many people you add to your biggest revenue-earning team, how much overtime everyone works, and how much more gets done in an hour. It leaves everything else you decided exactly alone — your revenue target, the growth you expect, the salary increase, the shift shares, the month new people arrive and the reality check. Nobody's job is at stake in any of this: the search only ever adds people to a plan. Each card is the least costly version of its direction. If no direction meets every goal, they are ranked by how few goals are missed, then by how narrowly. These are calculations from the numbers on this page, not predictions.
